scopedCoverageNotes.text: Official candidate-list coverage: the current county BOE homepage links the September18,2026 seven-page candidate PDF, publicly listed as modified September21. Every29 local office field/71 candidate names, full fusion parties and vote limits are prepared. All28 newly added office fields rely on that list; actual Nassau November3 sample ballots and later ballot replacements remain an explicit source gap. This packet does not claim Nassau sample-ballot completeness.

Shared Supreme10: the existing contest and14 candidacy IDs are reused. Nassau native list, current state certification and Suffolk current actual sample agree on the full14 names/fusion line sets and vote8. Both Nassau and Suffolk county whole-membership IDs are preserved and refreshed from the source-exact state certification header.

Nassau DistrictCourt2 consists of Hempstead town AND LongBeach city;3 NorthHempstead town;4 OysterBay town AND GlenCove city, under official court rule212.2. Allfive constituent whole divisions are linked to exact county-scoped court district IDs. Court2/4 are not narrowed to only their towns. County legislative districts1–19 retain precise IDs pending boundary/division joins.

Countywide Family Court is kept separate from shared state Supreme Court. Town office electorates use exact registered towns rather than villages/CDPs. No county legislative district is widened to Nassau County. School/special-district offices absent from the candidate list are not represented as verified absent or cancelled.

The list explicitly says subject to change and has no qualification/withdrawal/status columns. No late withdrawal, replacement or cancellation identity is inferred. Blank Write-in spaces do not identify people, and no separate current local declared-write-in certification has been established. Existing measures, legislative races and explainers are preserved by the partial merge.

Acquisition evidence includes current BOE/legacy/domain redirects, the public BOE DocumentCenter folder enumeration of319 documents, county search and city/town routes. It records the sample gap without asserting no sample exists. Replay scripts remain in scratch; this packet contains data and source evidence only. No production publication or git operation was performed.
